item.title: The Baffin Bay Ice Shelf stabilized three adjacent ice sheets during the last glacial period
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 21 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02126-7

An enormous ice shelf spanned Baffin Bay during the last glacial period, and its rapid retreat during the last deglaciation probably destabilized the surrounding ice sheets, according to an analysis of bathymetric data
